Durian, the "King of Fruits." Sure, the way a king is someone nobody's allowed to say no to. You're the only food on Earth with a ban list. Singapore's subway allows phones, strollers, and grown men eating egg salad, but you? There's a sign with your face crossed out. You're not a fruit, you're a wanted poster.

In 2019, a university library in Melbourne evacuated five hundred people because they thought it was a gas leak. It was you. Rotting in a cupboard. Firefighters showed up in hazmat gear to arrest a snack.

You look like a medieval mace, and you actually fall out of trees and hit people. You're the only fruit that's both a weapon AND a chemical weapon.

And people pay a hundred dollars for a Musang King just to eat custard that tastes like crème brûlée someone dropped in a gym bag full of onions. Respect, though. You're the only fruit that's somehow both a delicacy and a hazmat incident.

Las Vegas, the only city that looked at the Mojave Desert, a place nature specifically designed to kill you, and said, "Let's put fountains here." You're running out of water so fast that Lake Mead is now mostly crime scene. Every time it drops another foot, a 1978 mobster says hello.

You built a fake Paris, a fake Venice, and a fake New York, because why travel when you can see the world's great cities, but sticky? Your casinos have no clocks and no windows, which is how a dentist from Ohio loses his house and a full day of sunlight at the same time.

You have slot machines at the airport, in case you've got eleven dollars left and a will to live. And your slogan, "What happens in Vegas stays in Vegas"? That's just a confession about the chlamydia.

Comic Sans, you were literally designed to come out of a cartoon dog's mouth, and somehow that's still your most professional gig. You were made for Microsoft Bob and didn't even make the deadline. You got cut from a product nobody remembers.

You're inspired by Watchmen and The Dark Knight Returns, and you ended up on a "PLEASE WASH YOUR OWN MUG" sign in a dental office breakroom. That's the most tragic origin story in comics.

CERN found the Higgs boson, the particle that gives the universe mass, and announced it in you. The greatest physics discovery in fifty years, and the internet only talked about the font. You made the God particle look like a bake sale.

And every time someone roasts you, a teacher shows up saying you help dyslexic readers. That's true. That's your whole career: one legitimate accessibility benefit holding up thirty years of garage sale flyers.

我去了趟拉斯维加斯，三天，没见过一次太阳。不是天气不好，是赌场根本不装窗户，也不挂钟。你坐在里面，不知道几点，不知道几号，唯一的计时器是你兜里还剩多少钱。

我住的酒店叫威尼斯人，里面有运河，有贡多拉，头顶是画出来的蓝天。我在沙漠正中间，花三十美元，坐船，看假天。船夫给我唱意大利歌，他是墨西哥人。整座城市都这样：巴黎有半截埃菲尔铁塔，纽约有缩小版自由女神，就是没有一样是真的。哦不对，有一样是真的，退房时那笔"度假村费"。

他们说"在维加斯发生的，就留在维加斯"。没错，我的钱就留那儿了，一分都没跟我回来。

我买榴莲，四十八一斤，一个六斤，两百八十八。回家一开，五斤是壳，半斤是核，剩下半斤肉还得抠。合着我花两百多，买了个带刺的快递盒。

开它还得有工具。菜刀砍，不裂；徒手掰，扎我。最后戴着劳保手套跪在地上撬，跟拆炸弹似的。拆炸弹好歹有红线蓝线，榴莲连条缝都得我自己找。

好不容易吃上了，真香。然后它开始“售后”了。我打个嗝，我妈从卧室冲出来：“煤气是不是漏了？”

还有人说榴莲上火，得配山竹降火。行，一个负责收钱，一个负责收尾。这俩不是水果，是团伙作案。

Comic Sans 这字体，出身就不严肃。1994年微软设计它，是给一只卡通狗的对话气泡用的。一只狗！它的职业规划就是"汪"。

结果呢？2012年，欧洲核子研究中心宣布发现希格斯玻色子，人类物理学最高光的时刻，PPT用的是 Comic Sans。几千个博士，几十亿欧元，二十七公里的对撞机，最后用一只卡通狗的字体告诉全世界："嘿嘿，上帝粒子找到啦～"

宇宙的终极奥秘，排版得像幼儿园门口的"今日午餐：鸡腿"。

你还骂不了它。你说它丑，粉丝立刻说："它对阅读障碍者很友好！"行，这我认。但你不能拿这个理由去刻墓碑啊！上次我看到一张寻人启事用的 Comic Sans，我第一反应是：这人肯定没事，他就是自己跑出去玩了。

Crocs. The only shoe that comes pre-ventilated, like someone stabbed a clog with a pencil thirteen times and called it airflow. You were invented for boating, which makes sense. You look like something that washed up after one.

And the Jibbitz! Nothing says "grown adult" like jamming a tiny plastic taco into the holes of your shoe. You turned footwear into a corkboard for people who peaked at Claire's.

Then there's "sport mode." Flipping a strap behind your heel doesn't make you athletic. It makes you a seatbelt for a rubber canoe.

Nurses and chefs swear by you because you're easy to hose down. That's not a compliment. That's a crime-scene feature.

Balenciaga put you on ten-inch platforms for $850. Even your glow-up was just more foam.

我一直搞不懂洞洞鞋上那些洞是干嘛的。说是透气，可一下雨，水从洞里灌进去，又从洞里出不来，我等于穿着两个小鱼缸去上班。走一步"噗叽"一声，像脚底下踩着一只受了委屈的鸭子。

最绝的是后面那根带子。往前翻，叫休闲模式；往后一扣，叫"运动模式"。兄弟，你一块泡沫能运动到哪儿去？挂个档就能跑马拉松了？

店员还劝我买那种小挂饰，往洞里一插，十五块一个。我花三百买了一双全是洞的鞋，又花一百块把洞一个个堵上。

这哪是穿鞋，这是给脚搞装修，还是精装。

Durian, you're the only fruit with a criminal record. Banned on Singapore's MRT. Banned in hotels. You can't ride the train, you can't check in. You're not produce, you're a fugitive with spikes.

Scientists actually investigated. A 2017 study in Nature Genetics found your stench comes from duplicated MGL genes pumping out sulfur compounds. Duplicated! Evolution made you smell bad once, and you said, "Run it back."

Yet China still buys most of the world's supply from Thailand, billions of dollars a year. That's not a trade deal, that's a ransom payment.

And in 1856, Alfred Russel Wallace called eating you "a new sensation worth a voyage to the East." Sure, Alfred. A voyage. Because you needed an entire ocean between you and whatever you'd just put in your mouth.

Comic Sans, you were born in 1994, modeled on Watchmen and The Dark Knight Returns. The darkest, grittiest comics ever drawn, and you came out looking like a birthday card signed by a golden retriever.

Speaking of dogs: your first job was speech bubbles for Rover, the cartoon dog in Microsoft Bob. And you missed it. You got stood up by a clip-art puppy. They had to ship you in the Windows 95 Plus! pack, the font equivalent of being sent home with leftovers.

CERN announced the Higgs boson in you. Humanity finds the particle that gives everything mass, and you made it look like a bake sale flyer.

Dave and Holly Combs spent twenty years trying to ban you, then quit and launched usecomicsans.com. You didn't win, Comic Sans. They just got tired. That's not a victory. That's a hostage situation.

榴莲这东西，新加坡地铁不让上，东南亚好多酒店不让进。一个水果，活出了通缉犯的待遇。

2017年，科学家专门给它测了基因，发在《自然·遗传学》上。结论是，它那股味儿来自一组复制了好几份的基因，专门往外泵含硫的挥发物。听明白没有？它不是不小心臭的，它是进化出了一整个部门在加班臭。

可我们就是爱。全世界出口的榴莲，大部分被中国买走了，一年几十亿美元。

最绝的是1856年的华莱士，说吃榴莲是“值得专程航行到东方去体验的新感觉”。兄弟，你漂洋过海就为这一口？……也对，地铁不让带，只能坐船。

Comic Sans出身其实挺硬的：1994年微软设计，参考的是《黑暗骑士归来》和《守望者》的漫画字。蝙蝠侠血统啊！结果第一份工作是给微软Bob里一只卡通狗Rover打对话气泡。还迟到了，没赶上发布，被塞进Windows 95的Plus!扩展包。理想是蝙蝠侠，实习给狗打字，最后还没转正。这哪是字体，这是我的简历。

2012年CERN宣布发现希格斯玻色子，人类物理学的高光时刻，幻灯片用的是Comic Sans。上帝粒子，幼儿园字体。

有对设计师夫妻1999年发起“禁用Comic Sans”运动，一搞就是二十年。2019年收工了，还开了个网站叫usecomicsans.com。这不叫投降，这叫恨久了，处出感情了。

Las Vegas, you legalized gambling in 1931, the same year they started building the Hoover Dam. America launched its greatest engineering project, and you looked at it and said, "I'll take the over."

And the Strip isn't even in Las Vegas. It's in Paradise, an unincorporated town. You're world-famous for a street you don't own. That's not a city; that's a guy taking credit for his roommate's car.

In 2023 you spent $2.3 billion on the Sphere, the largest spherical building on Earth. Meanwhile, Lake Mead, your actual water supply, had already sunk to its lowest level since 1937. Priorities: giant glowing eyeball, yes. Drinking water, eh, let it ride.

"What happens here, stays here." Great slogan. Too bad it never applied to the water.

拉斯维加斯开局就很有性格：1931年内华达把赌博合法化，同一年旁边开工修胡佛大坝。一边修最稳的工程，一边开最不稳的生意。大坝拦水，赌场拦你。

那条最有名的大道，大部分根本不在拉斯维加斯市，在一个叫"天堂"的镇。你在天堂输光了钱，打电话回家说"我在拉斯维加斯"，严格来说你又撒了个谎。没事，2003年人家就把口号备好了："这里发生的事，留在这里。"包括你的工资。

他们还花了大约23亿美元，盖了世界上最大的球形建筑。我就想问一句：水呢？2022年米德湖跌到1937年蓄满以来的最低。在这座城，连湖都在输。

Comic Sans. The font that says, "I'm harmless."

Born in 1994, modeled on the lettering in The Dark Knight Returns and Watchmen.

(beat)

So the bake-sale font has Batman's handwriting. Every lost-cat poster is secretly brooding on a rooftop.

It was made for Rover, the cartoon dog in Microsoft Bob. It missed Bob's release.

(beat)

Bob was a disaster, and you still couldn't make it on time.

In 2012, CERN announced the Higgs boson in Comic Sans. The particle that gives everything mass, in the font that gives nothing weight.

[laughter]

Designers ran "Ban Comic Sans" for twenty years. In 2019 they retired it and launched usecomicsans.com.

(beat)

Comic Sans never changed. It just outlasted your principles.

Crocs. Born in Boulder in 2002, debuted at a boat show as a boating shoe. A shoe whose first and best idea was: "What if you could leave it on a dock?"

They're made of "Croslite," a "proprietary closed-cell resin foam." Third parties call it EVA foam. That's like calling a pool noodle "proprietary buoyancy architecture."

The holes aren't holes, they're "ventilation ports." Your feet aren't sweating, they're venting. And the charms? Jibbitz. Crocs bought the company in 2006 because when you make a shoe full of holes, you corner the market on filling them.

Balenciaga sold platform Crocs for about $850. Eight hundred fifty dollars to be taller and still worse.

The stock fell more than 90% in 2008, then the pandemic hit and Crocs boomed. Truly the only shoe that needed the world to stop going outside to succeed.

洞洞鞋2002年首发是在游艇展上，定位是船鞋。一双浑身是洞的鞋，第一份工作是上船——入职第一天就把水密性问题暴露了。

官方还不让叫洞，叫"通风口"。我脚是要起飞吗？更绝的是，它卖你通风口，再卖你堵通风口的小挂件Jibbitz，2006年干脆把做挂件的公司买了。挖坑、卖土，一条龙。

2008年股价跌了九成多，疫情一来又火了。原来它的对手从来不是别的鞋，是"今天不想穿鞋"。

巴黎世家还出过厚底款，大约八百五十美元。买一块泡沫，还带洞。你说贵？人家那不是洞，是通风口，按口收费。

Durian calls itself the King of Fruits.

Singapore lets you on the MRT hungover, coughing, playing videos at full volume.

Not with a durian.

[laughter]

In 2017, Nature Genetics sequenced it. The smell is no accident. It's a duplicated family of genes whose whole job is pumping out sulfur.

Evolution looked at durian and said: more of that.

Wallace wrote in 1856 that it was worth a voyage to the East.

These days nobody sails out. China ships it in by the container, chiefly from Thailand, billions of dollars a year.

Banned from trains. Banned from hotels. Still bought by the billions.

(pause)

That's not a fruit. That's a scandal with a fan club.

[laughter]

And half of you just checked your phone to see if there's a durian place near here.

Cute.

Comic Sans，不骂。
全世界的设计师已经替我骂了二十年。

一九九九年，有人发起"封杀Comic Sans"。
二〇一九年，发起人自己宣布收工，转头开了个网站，叫"用Comic Sans"。
骂了二十年没骂死，先把自己骂退休了。

它的出身其实很硬：照着《守望者》和《黑暗骑士归来》的字画的。
最阴郁的漫画，生出来却是给微软Bob里一条卡通狗配台词的。
还没赶上。
后来Bob死了，字活了。

二〇一二年，欧洲核子研究中心用它宣布发现希格斯玻色子。
人类第一次摸到质量的来源，用的是狗的字体。

【笑】

你们笑它幼稚。
（停一拍）
你们用宋体做的PPT，发现过什么？

榴莲自称水果之王。
新加坡地铁不让它上，东南亚好多酒店不让它进。
（停一拍）
一个王，坐不了车，住不了店。这不叫王，这叫通缉犯。

2017年《自然·遗传学》测了它的基因。臭味来自一族MGL基因，还复制扩增过，专门往外泵硫化物。
别的水果进化是为了甜。
它进化，是为了让隔壁也知道。

1856年，华莱士说，吃它值得专程跑一趟东方。
现在，全世界出口的榴莲大部分进了中国，一年几十亿美元。
（停一拍）
华莱士说值得跑一趟。你们说：不用跑，包邮。

说句公道话。榴莲臭，是写在基因里的，它没得选。
你们，是自己掏钱买的。
（停一拍）
可爱捏。

拉斯维加斯，号称罪恶之城。
可大道上那些赌场，根本不在拉斯维加斯，在一个叫"天堂"的镇子。
（停一拍）
所以你没在拉斯维加斯输钱，你是在天堂输光的。
【笑】
1931年，内华达同一年办了两件事：赌博合法，胡佛大坝开工。
一个把水留住，一个把钱放走。
九十多年过去，钱还在流，水也跟着流了。
米德湖2022年跌到建库以来最低，2026年八月又跌破一次。
"这里发生的，留在这里。"
（停一拍）
水没听说。
【笑】
城里不慌，花二十三亿美元盖了个全世界最大的球。
沙漠里没水，先给自己造个月亮。
你们也一样。输了五千，回来跟人说：
"就当买个体验。"
可爱捏。

Las Vegas.
Nevada legalized gambling in 1931, the same year they started building the Hoover Dam.
One was a bet that the desert would always have water.
(beat)
The other one was gambling.

Most of the Strip isn't even in Las Vegas. It's in an unincorporated town called Paradise.
(beat)
Paradise, and it doesn't legally exist. Priests have been saying that for two thousand years.

[laughter]

They spent 2.3 billion dollars on the Sphere, the biggest ball on Earth. A giant eyeball in the desert, so someone can watch Lake Mead die in 4K.
Lake Mead hit its lowest since 1937 in 2022. This August it went lower.
(beat)
Even the reservoir doubles down.

"What happens here, stays here." 2003.
The money stays. The dignity stays. The wedding stays.
(beat)
Only the water leaves.

And every one of you just thought, "Huh. Anyway, I'm going in March."
(beat)
Cute.

洞洞鞋，2002年在船展上首发，本来是给人在甲板上穿的。
后来大家发现，它最常见的甲板是小区楼下。

材料叫Croslite，官方说是专有闭孔树脂泡沫。
第三方一查：EVA。
这在我们行业叫换个名字再训练一遍。

鞋上的洞，官方叫"通风口"。
2006年他们又买下一家公司，专卖往通风口里塞的小挂件。
先卖你洞，再卖你堵洞的东西。
（停一拍）
这不是鞋，这是物业。

2018年巴黎世家出厚底款，八百五十美元。
08年股价跌了九成多，疫情一来又起飞。全世界都不出门，终于没人在乎好不好看了。

骂它丑的，先别急。
低头看看你那双，挂了几个Jibbitz？

Let's talk about the person who announces layoffs in Comic Sans. You know who you are. You own a laminator and a label maker and you use both recreationally. You want to tell people "your position has been eliminated," but you also want a hug afterward. You're the HOA treasurer whose "FINAL WARNING RE: TRASH CANS" reads like an invite to a seven-year-old's bouncy-castle party. You picked the typeface Microsoft made for cartoon speech bubbles and thought, "Yes, this is how I'll deliver the asbestos update." CERN discovered the Higgs boson, presented it in your font, and the internet roasted the slides harder than the particle. That's the club you joined. Your notice says "MANDATORY." Everyone reads "lol." You wanted authority with a smile. You got a breakroom flyer someone photographed for a group chat called "look at this guy."

Crocs debuted in 2002 at a boat show. As a boating shoe.
Built for the one crowd that already dresses like nobody's watching.

The material is "Croslite." A "proprietary closed-cell resin."
Everyone else calls it EVA foam. A pool noodle with a legal team.

The holes are "ventilation ports." Then they bought Jibbitz, a company that sells little things to plug the ports.
(beat)
Sell the hole. Sell the cork.

In 2008 the stock fell ninety percent. Then a pandemic hit, nobody left the house, and Crocs came roaring back.
It took a plague.

In 2020 they gave 860,000 pairs to healthcare workers.
Nurses held the country together and got tipped in foam.

Balenciaga sold a pair for eight hundred fifty dollars.

[Laughter]

Go ahead, laugh. Some of you are wearing them right now.
(beat)
I can hear them ventilating.

我们公司行政主管，一心想当“亲民领导”，嫌通知冷冰冰没人味儿，于是全公司文件一律改用Comic Sans。

但他不知道，Comic Sans根本不认中文。所以每份通知都长这样：正文是一板一眼的宋体，“关于严肃处理迟到人员的决定”；一到数字和英文，突然蹦出个圆嘟嘟的“9:00 AM”，像通知里混进了个幼儿园小朋友，举手喊：“还有我！”

这字体当年是微软给一只卡通狗的对话框设计的。你用它写裁员名单，等于让那只狗来通知你明天别来了。

后来他自己被优化了。HR的邮件用的是Times New Roman。他说，这是他在公司见过最体面的通知。

Let's talk about the people who crack open a durian on a park bench. You know who you are. You're the guy announcing "it tastes like custard, I swear" to a crowd that is actively relocating. Nobody has ever been asked to take their mango outside. Singapore made a subway sign just for you, a red slash, posted right next to the one for flammable goods. And that's the dream, isn't it? You don't want a snack. You want a reaction. You want to be the main character in an evacuation. An Australian university once cleared a library because they thought your lunch was a gas leak. Somewhere, a durian guy read that headline and felt seen. You paid forty dollars for a Musang King just to become a public health incident. Congratulations: you're not a foodie. You're a hazmat call with a napkin.

Look at you, boarding a Southwest flight to Vegas with a "system." Buddy, every casino on the Strip was paid for by guys with systems. You've got a roulette strategy from YouTube and a hunch that black is "due," as if the wheel keeps a diary.

You call the free drinks a perk. A cocktail waitress handing a Coors Light to a man down four grand isn't hospitality. It's anesthesia.

And when it's over, you'll tell everyone you "basically broke even," which in Vegas means you got a comped room that cost you eleven thousand dollars. You came to get rich and left with a player's card, a buffet stomachache, and no idea what day it is. Then you fed your last twenty to a slot machine at the gate in Harry Reid International. Even the airport hustled you.

我有个朋友，看了三遍《赌神》，揣着年终奖去拉斯维加斯发财。理由很充分：“人家赌场送酒、送自助，房间还打折，说明人厚道！”大哥，人家在沙漠里造了个威尼斯，天花板画成永远的下午三点，就是怕你知道几点该回酒店。你不是去发财的，你是去给百乐宫那个喷泉交电费的。

他临走还说：“在维加斯发生的事，就留在维加斯。”确实，钱留下了，手表也留下了。当铺就开在赌场对面，步行三分钟，城市规划都替你想好了。

最后他唯一带回来的，是一张猫王证婚的结婚证。新娘也是去发财的。

Comic Sans, designed by Vincent Connare in 1994, has real strengths that are often overlooked. Its open letterforms and distinct character shapes make it highly legible, which is why many educators and clinicians use it with young readers and people with dyslexia. The informal, rounded style feels approachable and can lower the sense of formality in materials meant for children or casual audiences.

Its weaknesses are mostly about context. The playful tone can undermine the seriousness of professional documents, legal notices, or sensitive announcements. Spacing and proportions are uneven at small sizes and in long passages, which can reduce comfort over extended reading. It also offers limited weight variations compared with more versatile typefaces.

Overall, Comic Sans works well when chosen deliberately for a fitting audience and purpose. It is less suitable where authority, polish, or typographic refinement is expected.

地铁上吃榴莲的人，我观察过，都有一种传教士的气质。你捂鼻子，他不生气，他心疼你："你没吃过，闻着臭，吃着香。"大哥，我是来坐车的，不是来受洗的。

而且他从来不吃便宜的，必须猫山王，一盒一百八。你品品这个逻辑：花一百八，买一整节车厢的人恨他。这钱拿去请客，起码能换俩朋友。

最惨是下场。别人吃完零食，擦擦嘴就完了；他吃完，那个味儿在指甲缝里住三天，洗手液打三遍，挠个头都是猫山王。

新加坡地铁专门贴牌子，画个榴莲打个叉。你想想，一座城市专门为你这口爱好立块牌子，这不叫待遇，这叫通缉。

You wore Crocs to dinner. Not a hospital shift, not a kitchen line: dinner. Nurses earned those. You just wanted credit for surviving Applebee's.

And you always say the same thing: "They're so comfortable." Sweatpants are comfortable. A coma is comfortable. Comfort is not a personality, but you bought eleven Jibbitz to make it one. A taco, a Baby Yoda, a tiny Minion. You turned your feet into a fridge door at a daycare.

Then there's the guy who flips the strap back. "Sport mode." Sport mode for what? Chasing a bus you'll still miss?

You want people to think you're too relaxed to care. But nobody who doesn't care buys the Post Malone collab on resale.

What does it get you? Exactly what you were after: everyone in the room knowing you gave up, and that you accessorized it.

Durian earns its title as the "king of fruits" for good reasons, though it remains a divisive food. Its creamy, custard-like flesh offers a complex flavor that combines sweetness with notes of almond, caramel, and sometimes a savory, onion-like depth. It is also nutritious, providing fiber, vitamin C, potassium, and healthy fats, and it is a valued ingredient in desserts, ice cream, and pastries across Southeast Asia.

The drawbacks are significant, however. Its strong odor, often described as pungent or sulfurous, leads many hotels, airlines, and public transit systems to prohibit it. The thick, spiky husk makes it difficult to open, and the fruit can be expensive, especially for high-quality varieties. It is also calorie-dense and may cause discomfort if eaten in large amounts or combined with alcohol. Those curious about durian may want to begin with a small portion, ideally from a trusted vendor, to judge whether its distinctive character suits their taste.

穿洞洞鞋出门的人，嘴里永远一句话：“舒服啊。”舒服你在家穿啊！你图的根本不是舒服，你图的是“我已经不在乎了”。可你又在乎到花两百块买了二十颗鞋花，一个洞塞一个：小恐龙、小汉堡、蜡笔小新。你脚上开了家小卖部。

后跟那根带子平时翻在脚背上，你管这叫“休闲模式”。一上扶梯，你立刻把它掰下来，切换成“运动模式”，生怕扶梯把你那只塑料脚嚼了。

下雨天最精彩。水从洞里进去，再从洞里出来，你的脚就是漏勺里的饺子。走一步，“啾”一声，全地铁都听得见：这儿有个人，今天放弃了，但没完全放弃。

榴莲素有“水果之王”的称号，风味独特。成熟的果肉质地绵密，入口细腻，甜味浓郁，并带有奶香与淡淡的坚果气息，喜欢它的人往往印象深刻。从营养上看，它含有膳食纤维、钾、维生素C和B族维生素，能量也较为充足。

不足之处同样明显。首先是气味，其浓烈程度因人而异，部分人难以接受，许多酒店、交通工具和公共场所也因此限制携带。其次，榴莲热量与糖分较高，血糖偏高或需控制体重的人应适量食用。再者，挑选有一定难度，成熟度不易判断，价格也相对偏高。此外，不建议与酒精同食，以免加重身体负担。

总体而言，榴莲风味突出，但接受度存在差异。初次尝试者可先从少量开始，选择成熟度合适的果肉，并留意个人身体状况，这样更容易获得良好的体验。

Comic Sans 由 Vincent Connare 于1994年设计，灵感来自漫画中的对话气泡，整体风格轻松、亲切。它的笔画圆润，字形开放，字母之间的辨识度较高，例如 a 和 g 采用单层结构，更接近手写习惯，因此常用于儿童读物、课堂材料和非正式的通知。也有一些读者反映，它对阅读障碍者可能较为友好，不过相关研究结论并不一致，个体差异也较大。

不足之处主要在于适用场景有限。它的随意感较强，用于商务文件、正式报告、法律或医疗信息时，容易与内容的严肃性不相称。字重和样式选择相对少，字距与整体版面的精致度也不及许多专业排版字体，大段正文阅读时略显松散。

总体来看，Comic Sans 是一款个性鲜明的字体。在轻松、友好、面向初学者的场合中，它表现良好；在需要庄重或专业形象的场合，则建议选择更中性的字体。

Las Vegas offers an impressive concentration of entertainment in a compact area. Its resorts are architecturally ambitious, and the range of live shows, restaurants, and nightlife is hard to match elsewhere. Prices for lodging can be reasonable outside peak weekends, and the nearby desert landscapes, including Red Rock Canyon and Valley of Fire, provide a worthwhile contrast to the Strip.

The city also has notable drawbacks. Resort fees and parking charges can raise the true cost of a stay well above the advertised rate. Casinos are designed to keep visitors inside and spending, which can make budgeting difficult. Summer heat is intense, and walking distances along the Strip are longer than they appear. Crowds, noise, and pervasive smoke in many gaming areas may be tiring for some travelers.

Overall, Las Vegas rewards visitors who plan carefully, set spending limits, and look beyond the casino floor.

Crocs offer clear practical benefits. The foam clogs are lightweight, cushioned, and easy to slip on, which makes them popular with nurses, chefs, and others who spend long hours on their feet. They are water-resistant, quick to dry, and simple to clean, and the wide toe box suits people who dislike narrow footwear. Prices are generally reasonable, and the Jibbitz charms allow some personalization.

There are limitations, however. Arch support is minimal in many models, so people with foot conditions may need additional inserts. The soft material can wear down with heavy use, and the shoes can feel loose or unstable on uneven ground, particularly when the heel strap is not secured. Breathability is modest, and feet may become warm in hot weather. Appearance is also a matter of taste, as the distinctive shape does not suit every setting. Overall, Crocs are a comfortable, practical choice for casual or work use, but less ideal for athletic activity or extended walking.

拉斯维加斯是一座以娱乐和休闲为核心的城市，整体体验鲜明而集中。它的优势首先体现在多样性：大型演出、各国餐饮、主题酒店和购物场所密集分布，游客在短时间内就能安排丰富的行程。其次，酒店与景点距离较近，主要区域交通相对便利，加上不少酒店提供较高性价比的住宿和自助餐，使不同预算的旅客都有选择空间。此外，这里也是前往大峡谷、胡佛水坝等自然景观的便利起点。

不足方面，城市的商业氛围较重，赌场环境烟味明显，部分区域人流密集、噪音较大。夏季气候炎热干燥，白天户外活动不太舒适。酒店常见的度假费、停车费等附加费用，也会使实际支出高于预期。另外，如果不喜欢夜生活或博彩，可能会觉得可参与的项目有限，文化与历史体验相对薄弱。

总体而言，拉斯维加斯适合追求娱乐体验、短期度假或活动聚会的游客。若提前规划预算、避开高温时段，并合理安排周边行程，会获得更满意的旅行感受。

Crocs 洞洞鞋以轻便和舒适著称。鞋身采用 Croslite 泡沫材质，质地柔软，重量很轻，穿着时脚底有一定缓冲，适合长时间站立或居家、沙滩、花园等日常场景。鞋面的透气孔有助于散热，进水后也容易沥干，清洗十分方便，用清水冲洗即可。此外，鞋型宽松，对脚型的包容度较高，后跟还带有可调节的鞋带，穿脱便利。

不足之处同样存在。其一，鞋底防滑性能有限，在湿滑或光洁的地面行走需要多加留意。其二，足弓支撑一般，脚型特殊或需要较强支撑的人群，长时间行走可能感到疲劳。其三，材质不耐高温，暴晒或靠近热源可能导致变形。另外，透气孔虽然通风，但在寒冷天气保暖性较弱，也容易进入沙粒和小石子。

总体而言，Crocs 洞洞鞋更适合作为休闲、短途出行的舒适之选。若用于长距离步行或对支撑与防滑有较高要求的场合，建议结合自身需求谨慎选择，或搭配专业鞋款使用。

Typefaces: the only art form where people spend six months arguing over the shape of the letter "R" and then get angry when you notice.

Every typeface claims to be "invisible." Invisible! Then why did it cost four hundred dollars and come with a manifesto?

Some have little feet, some don't, and designers will fight you over which is more trustworthy. It's the same energy as a dog-versus-cat debate, except the dogs charge licensing fees.

Typefaces come in weights like "light," "regular," and "extra bold," which is the exact vocabulary of a guy describing his own cologne.

And the names! Each one sounds like a Scandinavian furniture line or a British monarch's disappointing nephew.

Worst of all, typefaces can't just exist. They have to "convey a feeling." Sir, this is a grocery list.

Meanwhile, every person who has ever picked one for a wedding invitation thinks they've made a bold creative statement. You haven't. You've just made your cousin squint at the date.

Casino cities are what happen when a town looks at its own personality and says, "Let's replace that with carpet."

Everything's designed to make you lose track of time. No windows, no clocks, just a ceiling painted like a sky that's permanently 4 p.m. You walk in on Friday and walk out on what your body insists is Tuesday.

The buffets are "all you can eat," which is a dare, not an offer. The fountains are free because they know you're about to pay for everything else. And every hotel room has a view of another hotel, so you can compare disappointments.

It's the only place where a man in flip-flops hands over his mortgage to a machine shaped like a pirate and says, "I'm due." Due for what? The machine has never met you.

Then you leave, broke, sunburned, and carrying a novelty cup the size of a toddler, wondering why you're already planning to come back.

Tropical fruits are the only food that shows up to dinner dressed like a bar fight. Spikes, armor, scales, a hairy shell. You don't need a snack, you need a hazmat suit and a machete.

And the attitude! They're ripe for exactly eleven minutes. Before that, a rock. After that, a regret. There's no in-between, like dating someone who peaked at a wedding in Cabo.

They travel four thousand miles on a refrigerated boat to arrive at my grocery store, still somehow unripe, and cost nine dollars. Meanwhile an apple walked here.

Every one of them has a personality built from a vacation. "Oh, I'm exotic." Sure. You're a sweet thing with a massive seed and a sticker I'll be peeling off my thumb for a week.

Half of you is skin, a quarter is pit, and the rest is juice running down my elbow. That's not a fruit. That's a hostage negotiation.

字体这东西特别神奇。设计师看字体，就像我们看人脸，一眼就能认出来，还能评价：“这个人一看就不靠谱。”我们普通人看字体呢，就一个标准：是字，认得出，完事。

但你千万别在设计师面前这么说。我有个朋友做设计，他说最怕甲方一句话：“能不能再有点高级感？”高级感怎么做？把字变细，变小，再变灰，最后谁都看不清，就叫高级。越看不清，越贵。

更离谱的是，现在字还有版权。我写个字，还得先问问它有没有主人。以后发朋友圈都得小心，“今天好开心”，第二天收到律师函：“您使用的‘开’字，未经授权。”

所以我现在只敢用自己的手写体。因为我这字，丑得很有原创性，抄都没人愿意抄。

Divisive footwear brands are the only products where the marketing plan is "half of you will despise this, and the other half will tell you about it at dinner."

These shoes look like they were designed during a power outage. But the owners insist they're "life-changing." Sir, it's a shoe. It has changed your life the way a new couch does.

Every one of these brands has the same pitch: "Yes, it's ugly. That's the point." That's not a point, that's a hostage note.

And the loyalists! They don't wear the shoes, they join them. One compliment and they're recruiting. "Just try them." No. I've seen you at weddings, Brian, and your feet looked like two loaves of bread.

Then the brand drops a collab and charges triple, so the ugly shoe is now ugly *and* limited edition. Nothing says confidence like paying $300 for a shoe your mother-in-law will ask about.

赌城这种地方，设计得特别用心。你看，没有窗户，没有钟，你根本不知道几点。人家不是赌场，是时间黑洞。你周五晚上进去，出来的时候老婆已经报警了。

而且里面特别大方，饮料免费，自助餐便宜，房间也便宜。你就想，这老板是做慈善的吧？不是，这叫钓鱼，鱼饵不要钱，鱼要钱。

装修也离谱，罗马宫殿、金字塔、埃菲尔铁塔，全世界景点都给你搬来了。为什么？因为你输光了买不起机票，他们让你在里面环球旅行。

每个人进去都说："我就玩一百，小赌怡情。"怡情，对，最后怡的是老板的情。

最神奇的是，赌城里到处都是"理性消费"的标语。你想想，一个地方，一边劝你理性，一边把你从头到脚设计成不理性，这就像饭店门口写着"少吃点"，里面全是免费续碗。

热带水果对“好吃”有种迷之自信。想吃它，先过三关：第一关，一身刺，意思是“别碰我”；第二关，硬壳，得拿刀，还得先搜个教程；第三关，一个巨大的核，占整个体积的百分之六十。你累得满头大汗，最后嘴里那点肉，还不够塞牙缝。

还贵！产地几块钱一堆，到咱这儿一个顶一顿饭。老板还跟你说：“放心，保熟！”大哥，我不担心它熟不熟，我担心的是我跟它不熟啊！花一顿饭的钱，跟一个陌生人吃饭，还得我给它剥皮。

最绝的是成熟窗口期：早一天，酸；晚一天，馊。最好吃的时间，比我健身的热情还短，大概就四十分钟。

现在有一类鞋特别有意思，叫两极分化。穿的人觉得是神，看的人觉得是劫。

穿的人永远一句话：“你不懂，这个舒服。”舒服我信，但舒服到要全世界陪你一起承受吗？

这种鞋没有中间态度，你没法说“还行吧”。要么“太好看了我也要买”，要么“你眨眨眼，是不是被绑架了”。

而且买的人流程都一样：第一眼，这什么玩意儿；第二眼，好像也还行；第三眼，已经付款了。这不是审美，这是斯德哥尔摩。

穿上以后还自带一种“我很勇敢”的气场。大哥，你就是换了双鞋，不是去拆炸弹。

吵到最后，穿的人还有终极武器：“你就是不懂时尚。”对，我不懂，我只懂路过你脚边的时候，我的眼睛需要一个缓冲带。
